protocol.reference: Pinned pack loader and its published dependency versions; unmodified neural implementation
protocol.native: Production tokenizer, preprocessing, vision loader, prefill, and cached decoder; test-only tensor exports
protocol.decode: Up to64 greedy upstream steps; native uses the identical upstream continuation to compare conditional logits
protocol.interpretation: Report each gate separately; any failure prevents an overall parity claim. Tolerances are frozen before native/reference comparison. No sampled-output equivalence claim.
protocol.reference_prefill_positions: Explicit slices of unmodified upstream full-prompt get_rope_index output for image chunks; default scalar cache offset is only used during decode

baseline_receipt.changes: Test visibility and production request-stream wrapper only

final_candidate_receipt.variant: native upstream FP32 reciprocal/power rotary frequencies and Conv3d

release_chart.interpretation: One fresh-process greedy chart smoke per model; timings are not a resident throughput benchmark. Original sampled quality corpus was not rerun under these conditions.

limits: Two text and four image prompts per checkpoint; at most 64 continuation tokens each.
Teacher-forced conditional logits; no sampled-output equivalence or broad quality claim.
Original quality and throughput measurements belong to the previous executable.

rotary_ablation.control: Unmodified upstream vision layers receive final native rotary frequencies only; excluded from primary parity gates.
rotary_ablation.scope: 2B chart only; other failing cases are not proven by this ablation.
